technical.summary: Early momentum reversal signals (stoch/RSI crosses, volume spike, OBV bullish) show potential, but price remains below all key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud with weak trend strength (ADX 14.7), limiting conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 91 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (33/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (2 sales vs 1 purchase, all small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide no conviction support.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (381.76) with imminent FOMC event in 1 day creates severe near-term volatility risk; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 91 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Early momentum reversal signals (stochRSI/stoch crosses, 15x volume spike, OBV bullish, supertrend bullish) with price near support (121.44) offer technical entry setup in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains structurally below all major moving averages (9/21/50/200 EMA/SMA), Ichimoku cloud, and VWAP with weak trend strength (ADX 14.7), while extreme VIX crisis (381.76) and FOMC event in 1 day create severe volatility risk that overwhelms early momentum signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Early stochRSI/stoch momentum crosses with 15x volume spike and price at support (121.44) offer technical setup, but structural weakness below all major moving averages and Ichimoku cloud severely limits conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis (381.76) with FOMC event in 1 day creates severe near-term volatility that will likely overwhelm early momentum signals and trigger stop-outs before reversal can develop.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical shows early reversal signals but fundamental, sentiment, and risk agents all flag insufficient conviction; bear case dominates debate (8 vs 4).
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MMM position with 8 other Industrials open (31% sector concentration); adding here increases concentration risk without fundamental or smart-money support.
